title: BMS picks Texas for new $2.3B manufacturing campus
snippet: Bristol Myers Squibb’s $2.3 billion Houston manufacturing campus is part of the company’s larger $40 billion investment designed to bolster American innovation and manufacturing.

title: Sionna’s cystic fibrosis failure is a windfall for Vertex’s blockbuster franchise
snippet: A surprise flop in Phase 2a cystic fibrosis trial sent Sionna’s shares plummeting, but for Vertex, the news reinforced its standard-of-care standing with highly successful drugs like Trikafta.

title: aTyr will cut 60% of workforce, Arpeggio shutters
snippet: Follow along as BioSpace tracks job cuts and restructuring initiatives.

title: Jazz commits up to $1.3B to buy Actio, bolster epilepsy pipeline
snippet: Jazz Pharmaceuticals is reaching into its wallet once again, this time buying Actio Biosciences and an experimental therapy for KCNT1+ epilepsy, a form of the disease with no FDA-approved treatments.

title: All eyes on psychedelic drugmakers as Definium, Compass near major catalysts
snippet: Definium Therapeutics’ closely watched anxiety readout could further validate its single-dose LSD candidate, while Compass Pathways advances a psilocybin program through a rolling FDA filing.

title: AstraZeneca partners with CSPC to build Chinese biologics manufacturing plant
snippet: News of the joint venture comes months after AstraZeneca vowed to spend $15 billion in China by the end of the decade.

title: Tenax shares nosedive as heart failure drug fails in Phase 3
snippet: Patients treated with Tenax Therapeutics’ heart failure drug TNX-103 did not show significantly better functional performance—though Leerink analysts found biomarker improvements and subgroup analyses in elderly and more severe patients “very encouraging.”

title: BlossomHill, Latigo bloom on Nasdaq with oversubscribed IPOs
snippet: BlossomHill Therapeutics will use its $150 million IPO proceeds to power the Phase 1/2 development of a non-small cell lung cancer drug, while Latigo Therapeutics will bring in more than $345 million for its late-stage non-opioid pain pill.

title: BioMarin axes asset from $270M Inozyme takeover, ending run in rare metabolic indication
snippet: BioMarin’s discontinued drug showed biomarker benefits in a Phase 3 study for ENPP1 deficiency but these failed to translate to clinical improvements.

title: Denali climbs past Avlayah expectations with $3.6M in revenue
snippet: After launching in April, Hunter syndrome drug Avlayah surprised analysts with a strong first quarter, as patients rush to get access to Denali Therapeutics’ new option.

title: Biogen’s targeted ALS treatment is reversing decline in some patients. Can more be helped?
snippet: Three years after Qalsody was approved by the FDA as the first drug to target a genetic cause of ALS, some patients are reporting not only disease stabilization but also improvement of symptoms.
